shared_elements: upright rectangular slab (stela) with carving on its principal face
low relief carving rather than incision or openwork
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief carving on a single principal face, and B's visible motif is a curved, scroll-like relief element of the sort that also appears within A's composition, which is the most that can be said. A presents a full, dense iconographic programme — a frontal standing figure in an elaborate plumed headdress, ornaments, flanking and basal panels of block-like signs — whereas B's surface shows only a single sparse curvilinear mark on an otherwise blank field, with no figure, no headdress and no sign blocks.
